title: Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.30425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. translated_title: 通过序列标注与方面码切换增强的生成式模型改进跨语言方面级情感分析
translated_abstract: 跨语言方面级情感分析（ABSA）将带有标注数据的源语言知识迁移到目标语言，从而在无需目标语言标注数据的情况下实现细粒度情感分析。尽管单语ABSA已取得显著进展，但跨语言ABSA仍未得到充分探索，尤其是对于涉及多个情感元素的复杂任务，例如目标-方面-情感检测（TASD）。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的SeqLab框架，利用序列到序列模型增强跨语言ABSA，通过编码器执行辅助序列标注任务，从而提升方面术语识别和情感预测能力。此外，我们引入了方面码切换（ACS）技术，这是一种基于翻译的方法，在源语句和翻译语句之间交换方面术语，生成额外的训练数据以增强模型的跨语言理解能力。我们在多个……上评估了我们的方法（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种结合编码器辅助序列标注任务（SeqLab）与方面码切换（ACS）数据增强技术的新型生成式框架，显著提升了跨语言方面级情感分析中方面术语识别与情感预测的性能。
en_tdlr: A novel SeqLab framework that combines an auxiliary sequence-labelling task in the encoder with aspect-code switching data augmentation significantly improves aspect term recognition and sentiment prediction in cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis.
